aglăŏphōtis , ĭdis, f., = ἀγλαοφωτις (splendidly bright).
I. A magic herb of a brilliant color: “aglaophotim herbam, quae admiratione hominum propter eximium colorem acceperit nomen,” Plin. 24, 17, 102, § 160 .—
II. The peony (Paeonia officinalis, Linn.), App. Herb. 65.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
